battle.name: 阿根廷獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 中文維基「戰爭列表」所列阿根廷獨立戰爭，是阿根廷革命與西班牙殖民當局為政治獨立及統治權而發生的武裝衝突。1810年5月布宜諾斯艾利斯啟動獨立進程後，愛國派與西班牙殖民軍在阿根廷本土交戰；火繩槍（Matchlock musket，1520年）則是此前已列裝的早期陸軍火器。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 一八一〇年的戰區不能直接套用今日阿根廷或智利的國界。西班牙王國藉維拉諾斯總督管治拉普拉塔河流域，守軍由總督府直屬部隊、各省效忠西班牙的正規營與地方守備隊組成；布宜諾斯利斯換成立憲會議後，原總督區各省陸續出現支持新政府的省級議會、民兵與野戰軍，但「拉普拉塔各省聯合體」直到一八一六年才正式成為國名。主要戰線由布宜諾斯利斯溯帕拉納河至羅薩里奧，再穿過科爾多瓦、薩爾塔與土秘魯；另一條東線越烏拉圭河指向蒙得維的亞，並自一八一七年起承受葡萄牙巴西軍占領的壓力；西線則由聖胡安與門多薩穿越安第斯山進入智利，之後沿海岸北上秘魯。因此，本文從一八一〇年五月接管開始，續寫一八一八年智利決定性戰役，以及北方戰區延續至一八二四年阿亞庫喬與一八二五年卡亞俄投降的終局。
countriesEn: The 1810 theater cannot be mapped directly onto the borders of present-day Argentina or Chile. Spain governed the Río de la Plata basin through the Viceroyalty, maintaining field troops, provincial regular units, and local garrisons loyal to the Spanish crown. After Buenos Aires replaced the viceroy with a governing junta, provincial councils, militias, and field armies throughout the former viceroyalty declared support for the new government, although the official name United Provinces of the Río de la Plata was not adopted until 1816. The principal northern route ran from Buenos Aires up the Paraná to Rosario, then through Córdoba, Salta, Tucumán, and Upper Peru. An eastern axis crossed the Uruguay toward Montevideo and encountered the Portuguese-Brazilian occupation from 1817 onward. The western route passed through San Juan and Mendoza, crossed the Andes into Chile, and then followed the coast north toward Peru. This account therefore begins with the transfer of authority in May 1810, treats the decisive Chilean campaign of 1818 as a major stage rather than the final settlement, and follows the northern theater through Ayacucho in 1824 and the surrender of Callao in 1825.
people: 巴爾塔薩·伊達爾戈·德·西斯內羅斯任維拉諾斯總督，至五月二十日辭職。五月十八日，科內利奧·薩阿維德拉在市議會公開開議後接管臨時政府；五月二十二日第一執政會議成立，五月二十五日就任，九名成員為米格爾·阿斯庫埃納加、馬里亞諾·德·維拉、胡安·何塞·帕索、曼努埃爾·阿爾韋蒂、多明戈·馬特烏、胡安·何塞·卡斯特利、曼努埃爾·貝爾格拉諾、胡安·加雷與多明戈·弗倫奇。貝爾格拉諾自六月三日起率領北方軍，卻在一八一〇年十月的維爾卡普希奧與阿亞庫喬連遭挫敗；何塞·馬里亞·帕斯曾整頓軍隊並推行較嚴格的野戰指揮，聖馬丁隨後接掌北方軍，於一八一一年土庫曼取勝，再於一八一三年重掌兵權。何塞·隆德奧、拉米爾丁、赫克托爾·索萊爾與曼尼在一八一二年的上秘魯遠征中相繼指揮失敗。安第斯階段的核心人物則是聖馬丁、曼努埃爾·德·薩拉特亞、貝納多·奧伊金斯、托馬斯·科克倫與拉斯·埃拉斯；北方終局由西蒙·玻利瓦爾授權、安東尼奧·何塞·德·蘇克雷指揮的愛國軍，對抗何塞·德拉塞爾納率領的西班牙王軍。
peopleEn: Baltasar Hidalgo de Cisneros served as viceroy until his resignation on May 20. On May 18, following the opening of the Cabildo, Cornelio Saavedra took control of the provisional government. The First Junta was formed on May 22 and took office on May 25 with nine members: Miguel de Azcuénaga, Mariano de Vera, Juan José Paso, Manuel Alberti, Domingo Matheu, Juan José Castelli, Manuel Belgrano, Juan Garay, and Domingo French. Belgrano took command of the Army of the North on June 3 but suffered successive defeats at Vilcapugio and Ayacucho in October 1810. José María Paz reorganized that army and imposed stricter field command before his capture in May 1811. San Martín then assumed control, won at Tucumán in 1811, and returned to command in 1813. José Rondeau, Lamadrid, Héctor Soler, and Maní led the disastrous Upper Peru expedition of 1812 in succession. The central figures of the Andean phase were San Martín, Manuel de Sarratea, Bernardo O'Higgins, Thomas Cochrane, and Las Heras. In the northern finale, forces directed by Antonio José de Sucre under Simón Bolívar confronted the royalist army commanded by José de la Serna.
kits: 本戰初期的裝備須限於一八一〇年以前已經列裝的項目。正規西班牙步兵使用一八〇二年制燧發步槍，即Fusil de infantería modelo 1802，並配用與槍身相合的套筒刺刀；騎兵則可見一七九五年制騎兵槍Carabina de caballería modelo 1795，以及一八〇二年制輕騎兵馬刀Sable de caballería modelo 1802。布宜諾斯利斯與各省接收總督府武器庫、軍械站及省級守備隊留下的槍械，但北方軍成立之初並非人人同時配齊火槍，部分民兵仍使用各團庫存中的舊槍與不同色制服。西班牙步兵的深藍色短上衣、按團分配的翻領、白色長褲、黑色綁腿及黑色雙角帽仍可辨認，偏遠地區則常以省級民兵團的既有裝備維持。砲隊使用青銅口徑滑膛迫擊炮，包括四磅、六磅、八磅及較重的十二磅砲，配置實心圓彈與霰彈，後備彈藥由砲車前車及彈藥箱運送。步兵以分格彈藥盒、背包、口糧袋和帶蓋水壺隨軍攜行。安第斯軍仍使用同代火槍與砲兵裝備，並大量依靠馬匹、驢、鞍架、備用蹄鐵、斧具和野營器材維持山區行軍。
kitsEn: The equipment available at the beginning of this war had to be restricted to patterns already in service by 1810. Regular Spanish infantry used the Model 1802 flintlock musket, Fusil de infantería modelo 1802, with a socket bayonet fitted to the musket. Cavalry formations could also receive the Model 1795 cavalry carbine, Carabina de caballería modelo 1795, and the Model 1802 light cavalry sabre, Sable de caballería modelo 1802. Buenos Aires and the provinces took over muskets from viceregal arsenals, military depots, and provincial garrisons, but the new Army of the North did not initially place a musket in every soldier's hands at once. Provincial militia contingents continued using older weapons and differing uniforms from their own company stocks. The Spanish infantry dark-blue coatee, regimental facings, white trousers, black gaiters, and black bicorne remained recognizable, although distant formations often relied on provincial militia dress. Artillery batteries used bronze smoothbore muzzle-loading guns in four-, six-, eight-, and heavier twelve-pound designations, firing solid round shot and canister. Reserve ammunition traveled on limbers and separate wagons. Infantry carried divided cartridge boxes, knapsacks, haversacks, and covered canteens. The Army of the Andes retained the same generation of muskets and artillery equipment while relying heavily on horses, mules, pack saddles, spare horseshoes, axes, and camp equipment for its mountain marches.
tactics: 一八一〇年北方軍的失敗顯示，密集線列若把火炮、行李與分散營隊夾在中間，會在崎嶇道路和突襲中迅速失去完整陣形；維爾卡普希奧與一八一〇年阿亞庫喬的西班牙騎兵由側翼包圍後切斷退路，使貝爾格拉諾各縱隊無法互相掩護。聖馬丁在土庫曼採用受控後撤，先拉長何塞·馬里亞·帕斯所建立的王軍前線，再以中央突進、兩翼同時進攻和預留兵力打擊其失去聯絡的部分，而不是在不利條件下立刻決戰。安第斯軍於一八一七年把全軍分為五個縱隊，各走不同山口，先完成通信、糧秣與接應點安排，再於聖羅莎營集結；這種分段突破縮短了後勤隊列，並使智利王軍無法集中封鎖所有山口。聖地牙哥突然陷落後，軍隊立即控制海岸與城郊道路，科克倫的艦隊則從海上威脅王軍退路。馬伊普戰役中，愛國步兵在砲火下越過灌溉渠向前推進，炮兵集中支援缺口，騎兵預備隊在王軍中央失穩時投入衝擊，迫使拉斐爾·馬羅托部向安第斯方向退卻。一八二四年阿亞庫喬的北方決戰則以高地防線承接王軍反覆攻擊，待其步兵脫離陣地後由愛國騎兵發動反衝，終於摧毀其攻勢。
tacticsEn: The defeats of the Army of the North in 1810 demonstrated how quickly a linear formation could be broken apart when artillery, baggage, and separated battalions were interleaved along rough roads. At Vilcapugio and Ayacucho in 1810, Spanish cavalry enveloped the flanks and cut the retreat route, preventing Belgrano's separated columns from supporting one another. At Tucumán, San Martín used a controlled withdrawal to extend the royalist front established by José María Paz, then attacked the center and both flanks simultaneously while committing reserves against the disconnected portions of the enemy line. He avoided immediate decisive combat under unfavorable conditions. In 1817, the Army of the Andes divided into five columns using separate mountain passes. Each column handled communications, supplies, and intermediate depots before the army reassembled at the Santa Rosa camp. This divided advance shortened the vulnerable supply columns and denied the Chilean royalist command a single point at which it could block every route. After the surprise seizure of Santiago, the army secured the coastal approaches and roads around the city, while Cochrane's squadron threatened the royalist retreat from the sea. At Maipú, patriot infantry advanced across irrigation channels under artillery fire, the batteries concentrated on weak points, and mounted reserves struck the royalist center as it lost cohesion, forcing Rafael Maroto's army back toward the Andes. At Ayacucho in 1824, patriot troops on high ground absorbed repeated royalist attacks and exploited the moment when royalist infantry separated from its formation; patriot cavalry countercharged and destroyed the attack.
data: 一八一〇年一月一日，西斯內羅斯撤往蒙得維的亞的計畫受軍隊阻撓而作罷，總督權仍留在布宜諾斯利斯。五月十八日傳到西班牙王位崩潰的消息後，薩阿維德拉接管臨時政府；五月二十日西斯內羅斯辭職，第一執政會議於五月二十二日至二十五日完成組成與就任。六月三日，貝爾格拉諾奉命組織北方軍，六月初由布宜諾斯利斯出發，七月六日抵達羅薩里奧，七月十六日在維利亞德爾羅薩里奧作戰，八月二十一日進入科爾多瓦，十月初推進至卡塔馬卡附近的拉斯拉古納斯。十月八日他在維爾卡普希奧失利，退往阿亞庫喬後於九日再戰失敗；部分官方年表把兩役併列於十月八日。貝爾格拉諾退回土庫曼，聖馬丁於十月接掌軍隊。一八一一年二月二十日至二十一日的克雷拉與聖安東尼奧戰役打開胡胡伊方向，三月三十一日占領薩爾塔，九月二十四日在土庫曼擊潰拉米爾丁指揮的王軍，隨後再進上秘魯。一八一二年間，佩德羅·阿方西諾·皮薩羅於四月七日重入薩爾塔，隆德奧與拉米爾丁的北方軍於九月四日在拉西烏德拉爾敗退；曼尼率領的遠征軍則在九月二十四日羅德奧德爾梅迪奧失敗。一八一三年聖馬丁重掌北方軍，一八一四年開始籌劃安第斯軍，一八一六年二月一日抵達門多薩，七月九日拉普拉塔各省聯邦宣告獨立。安第斯軍編制名冊約有三千四百人、一千九百匹馬及十六門砲，實際越嶺人數低於名冊；各縱隊在一八一七年一月至二月間以二十二天穿越五個山口，二月十二日在聖羅莎營會合，八月十九日突然進入聖地牙哥。一八一八年四月五日，軍隊在馬伊普擊敗智利王軍，智利於九月十八日正式宣告獨立。聖馬丁於一八二〇年由帕拉卡斯與皮斯科進入秘魯，一八二一年八月六日在胡寧取勝，因馬匹、糧秣及後續支援不足而撤回。蘇克雷其後由卡哈馬卡向阿亞庫喬推進，一八二四年十二月九日摧毀塞爾納的王軍主力，卡亞俄守軍至一八二五年一月二十四日投降。
dataEn: On January 1, 1810, Cisneros's plan to withdraw to Montevideo was blocked by his troops, leaving viceregal authority in Buenos Aires. News of the collapse of the Spanish monarchy reached the city on May 18, after which Saavedra assumed control of the provisional government. Cisneros resigned on May 20, and the First Junta was formed and took office between May 22 and May 25. Belgrano was appointed to organize the Army of the North on June 3. It left Buenos Aires in early June, reached Rosario on July 6, fought at Villa del Rosario on July 16, entered Córdoba on August 21, and advanced to Las Lagunas near Catamarca in early October. He lost at Vilcapugio on October 8 and fought again at Ayacucho on October 9, although several official Argentine chronologies list both battles under October 8. Belgrano retreated to Tucumán, where San Martín assumed command in October. Victories at Quera and San Antonio on February 20–21, 1811, opened the route toward Jujuy. The army occupied Salta on March 31 and defeated a royalist force at Tucumán on September 24 before advancing again into Upper Peru. During 1812, Pedro Antonio Pizarro re-entered Salta on April 7. The northern army commanded successively by Rondeau and Lamadrid was defeated at La Ciudadela on September 4, while Maní's expeditionary army lost at Rodeo del Medio on September 24. San Martín recovered command of the northern army in 1813, began planning the Army of the Andes in 1814, and arrived in Mendoza on February 1, 1816. The United Provinces declared independence on July 9. The Army of the Andes had an authorized establishment of approximately 3,400 men, 1,900 horses, and sixteen guns, although fewer men actually completed the crossing. Separate columns crossed five passes over twenty-two days in January and February 1817, reunited at the Santa Rosa camp on February 12, and entered Santiago unexpectedly on August 19. On April 5, 1818, the army defeated the Chilean royalist forces at Maipú, and Chile formally declared independence on September 18. San Martín entered Peru through Paracas and Pisco in 1820 and won at Junín on August 6, 1821, before withdrawing because horses, provisions, and adequate reinforcement were unavailable. Sucre later advanced from Cajamarca toward Ayacucho, destroyed the field army under La Serna on December 9, 1824, and received the surrender of the Callao garrison on January 24, 1825.
cause: 獨立戰爭的直接背景是一八〇八年西班牙王權的連續崩解。斐迪南七世退位、波旁王室在巴約即位及拿破崙控制馬德里，使美洲殖民地收到的王室命令失去可信度。塞維亞成立而後遷往加的斯的最高中央委員會試圖組織西班牙本土與美洲的防務，但 命令從歐洲抵達拉普拉塔需時數月，維拉諾斯總督、西班牙軍官與各省守備隊因而出現不同效忠對象。五月革命的直接原因則是布宜諾斯利斯市議會與駐軍拒絕讓西斯內羅斯恢復舊有權力，並組織新政府接管總督的行政與軍事權。這個決定沒有立即獲得各省一致支持，地方議會一方面承認接管，另一方面堅持自身的徵召、指揮與收入權力；一八一二年的北方軍潰敗後，布宜諾斯利斯中央軍與地方軍的衝突更加明顯。西班牙仍保有受過訓練的正規營、砲兵、烏拉圭與上秘魯的要塞，以及從山區通往秘魯的後勤路線，而革命軍必須自行建立軍官、徵集、供應與騎兵來源。因此，一八一〇年的軍事目標是奪回上秘魯，維持後來則轉向穿越安第斯山解放智利，並從智利沿海進入秘魯。
causeEn: The immediate background to the independence war was the progressive destruction of legitimate Spanish royal authority in 1808. The abdication of Ferdinand VII, the installation of the Bourbon dynasty at Bayonne, and Napoleon's occupation of Madrid deprived colonial orders from Spain of credibility. The Supreme Junta first formed in Seville and later moved to Cádiz attempted to organize the defense of Spain and its American territories, but communications from Europe took months to reach the Río de la Plata. Viceroy Cisneros, Spanish officers, and provincial garrisons consequently developed conflicting loyalties. The immediate cause of the May uprising was the refusal of the Buenos Aires Cabildo and the local garrison to allow Cisneros to restore the former system of authority. They organized a new government that assumed the viceregal administrative and military powers. That decision was not accepted uniformly. Provincial councils recognized the transfer while defending their own powers of recruitment, command, and revenue; after the northern army collapsed in 1812, conflict between centrally commanded and provincial forces became more pronounced. Spain still retained trained regular battalions, artillery, strong positions at Montevideo and in Upper Peru, and the logistical routes leading from the highlands into Peru. The revolutionary forces had to create their own officer structure, recruitment system, supply network, and mounted troops. Their initial military objective in 1810 was therefore the recovery of Upper Peru, followed later by a crossing of the Andes into Chile and a northward campaign along the Chilean coast into Peru.
impact: 五月權力轉移首先終止了維拉諾斯總督在布宜諾斯利斯的實際統治，並把外交、徵召、軍費與省際協調置於新執政機構之下。然而，北方軍、上秘魯遠征軍與安第斯軍分別依靠不同省份的人力、馬匹和補給，顯示中央政府不能長期以單一命令運作所有軍隊。一八一一年薩爾塔與土庫曼的勝利建立了短期攻勢，一八一二年的拉西烏德拉爾與羅德奧德爾梅迪奧失敗則使軍隊損失、地方指揮權與中央政治衝突同時加劇。安第斯軍的跨山行動產生了新的後勤制度：分散縱隊、預設接應點、輕裝砲隊、足量替換馬匹及分散糧食，都直接影響此後山區戰役。一八一六年聯邦宣告獨立後，北方軍並未永久控制上秘魯，促使聖馬丁把主要力量轉向智利；科克倫的海上合作、奧伊金斯的陸軍與後來智利自己的行政及軍事機構，使智利得以在馬伊普後維持獨立。秘魯方面，聖馬丁與蘇克雷的接續作戰改變了王軍在安第斯以南的部署，也迫使西班牙當局把主要兵力集中於利馬、卡亞俄及內陸高原。東方邊界則未同時解決，蒙得維的亞仍由葡萄牙巴西軍占領，成為與北方山地戰區性質不同的長期前線。
impactEn: The transfer of authority in May ended the effective exercise of viceregal rule in Buenos Aires and placed diplomacy, recruitment, military finance, and interprovincial coordination under a new government. The Army of the North, the Upper Peru expedition, and the Army of the Andes nevertheless depended on different provincial sources of manpower, horses, and supplies, demonstrating that a central authority could not operate every field army through a single chain of command. The victories at Salta and Tucumán in 1811 created a temporary offensive momentum, but the defeats at La Ciudadela and Rodeo del Medio in 1812 intensified military losses, disputes over provincial command, and political conflict with the central government. The Andean crossing produced a new logistical system based on separate columns, prepared rendezvous points, light artillery formations, large numbers of remounts, and distributed food supplies. These practices directly affected later mountain operations. After the federal declaration of independence in 1816, the northern army did not secure permanent control of Upper Peru, leading San Martín to transfer his principal effort to Chile. Cochrane's maritime cooperation, O'Higgins's army, and the institutions subsequently created by Chile itself allowed Chilean independence to continue after Maipú. In Peru, the successive campaigns of San Martín and Sucre altered the royalist deployment south of the Andes and forced Spain to concentrate much of its strength around Lima, Callao, and the interior highlands. The eastern frontier was not settled at the same time. Montevideo remained under Portuguese-Brazilian occupation and developed into a separate strategic front from the northern mountain theater.
result: 戰爭的結果應分三個軍事階段判斷。一八一〇年五月結束的是維拉諾斯總督權；一八一二年北方軍未能將戰線固定在上秘魯，烏拉圭河以東的蒙得維的亞也仍掌握在葡萄牙巴西軍手中。一八一七年至一八一八年的安第斯軍跨越成功，並在聖地牙哥與馬伊普迫使智利王軍放棄首都，智利王軍隨後退回安第斯山另一側，智利得以建立自己的政府、國會與軍隊。馬伊普解決的是智利戰區的決定性軍事問題，卻沒有讓阿根廷永久控制整個上秘魯，也不代表西班牙在秘魯的王軍主力當時已被消滅。聖馬丁其後把主要兵力轉往秘魯，一八二一年胡寧勝利後因騎兵、糧秣與政治支援不足而退出；蘇克雷於一八二四年十二月九日在阿亞庫喬摧毀塞爾納指揮的王軍野戰主力，一八二五年一月二十四日卡亞俄投降，拉普拉塔與秘魯地區有組織的西班牙王軍至此失去主要支撐。上秘魯隨後成為玻利维亚建國的行政基礎，未被阿根廷永久納入；蒙得維的亞直到一八二八年才由巴西軍隊交還。由此，拉普拉塔各省聯合體完成國家獨立，智利與秘魯也分別維持武裝與政治生存，但安第斯山地、東部邊界及上秘魯的最終安排仍由一八二〇年代後續軍事與外交行動決定。
resultEn: The outcome must be understood in three distinct military stages. The transfer of viceregal authority ended in Buenos Aires in May 1810. In 1812, the northern army failed to establish a permanent front in Upper Peru, while Portuguese-Brazilian forces still held Montevideo east of the Uruguay. The successful crossing of the Andes in 1817 and 1818 forced the royalist army in Chile to abandon its capital after the fighting around Santiago and Maipú. That army withdrew to the far side of the Andes, allowing Chile to establish its own government, congress, and army. Maipú settled the decisive military question in Chile, but it neither gave Argentina permanent possession of Upper Peru nor destroyed the main Spanish royalist field army in Peru. San Martín subsequently transferred his principal force to Peru. After the victory at Junín in 1821, he withdrew because adequate mounted troops, provisions, and political support were unavailable. Sucre destroyed La Serna's main field army at Ayacucho on December 9, 1824, and Callao surrendered on January 24, 1825, removing the principal organized support of the Spanish royalist cause in the Río de la Plata and Peruvian theaters. Upper Peru was not permanently incorporated into Argentina and became the administrative basis of Bolivia. Montevideo was not returned until 1828. The United Provinces therefore achieved national independence, while Chile and Peru established their own political and military survival. Final arrangements over the Andean highlands, the eastern frontier, and Upper Peru remained subjects of later military and diplomatic decisions in the 1820s.
